# Whatsable API errors: access, missing resources and limits

A tool that fails answers one of these codes, with its meaning and how to fix it. `insufficient_scope` and `feature_not_in_plan` are access and plan, not a fault: say what is missing. A failed send names Meta's code: read it in the WhatsApp error files.

| Code | HTTP | Meaning | How to fix | Who fixes it | Retry helps |
|---|---|---|---|---|---|
| `validation_failed` | 400 | A field in the request is missing, has the wrong type, or breaks a rule. Nothing was sent or saved. | Read `param` for the field and fix it, then retry. The same Idempotency-Key may be reused, because a request that failed validation is not stored. | The request or the account must change | no |
| `invalid_address` | 400 | `to` is not an E.164 phone number, a Business-Scoped User ID (such as US.13491208655302741918), or a WhatsApp username starting with @. | Send the phone in international form (+5491155550000), the contact's wa_user_id, or @username. To reply in an existing chat, send conversation_id instead. | The request or the account must change | no |
| `template_variable_missing` | 400 | The template needs a value the request does not set, so the message was not sent. | Read GET /v1/templates/{id} for the variables this template needs, and set every required one in template.variables. | The request or the account must change | no |
| `invalid_cursor` | 400 | The cursor is not one this API issued, or it is older than 24 hours. | Start the list again without a cursor, then follow next_cursor from each page. | The request or the account must change | no |
| `from_conflicts_with_conversation` | 400 | A message to an existing conversation always leaves from that conversation's number, and `from` names a different one. | Leave `from` out when you send conversation_id, or send `to` instead to choose the number yourself. | The request or the account must change | no |
| `media_too_large` | 400 | The file is larger than this use of it allows. An upload to POST /v1/media takes up to 100 MB; a send takes WhatsApp's limit for its type: 5 MB for an image, 16 MB for audio and video, 100 MB for a document, 500 KB for a sticker. An AI bot's files have the dashboard's limits. | Use a smaller file. For a send, a document allows the largest size, so a large image or video can go out as a document. `param` names the file that is too large. | The request or the account must change | no |
| `media_type_unsupported` | 400 | The file is not of a type this endpoint accepts. The type is read from the file's content, not from its name or the declared content type. | Convert the file to a supported type, such as JPEG or PNG for an image, MP4 for a video, or PDF for a document, and upload it again. | The request or the account must change | no |
| `api_key_missing` | 401 | The request carries no API key. | Send the key in the Authorization header: `Authorization: Bearer nfy_live_...`. Create a key in Settings, API. | The request or the account must change | no |
| `invalid_api_key` | 401 | The API key is not one Whatsable knows, or it has been revoked. | Copy a current key from Settings, API and send it as `Authorization: Bearer <key>`. | The request or the account must change | no |
| `api_key_in_wrong_place` | 401 | The key was sent in the query string, in the body, or in the Authorization header without `Bearer`. v1 reads it only as a Bearer token, because a key in a URL ends up in logs it can never be removed from. | Move the key to the Authorization header as `Authorization: Bearer <key>`. If the key was ever in a URL, revoke it in Settings, API and create a new one. | The request or the account must change | no |
| `legacy_api_key_not_accepted` | 401 | This key was imported from the previous Whatsable system. It still works on the old endpoints, and v1 does not accept it. | Create a new key in Settings, API and use it with v1. | The request or the account must change | no |
| `invalid_access_token` | 401 | This access token does not belong to a live Whatsable connection. It has expired, the connection was revoked in Settings, API, or the person who connected it is no longer an owner or admin of the organization. | Refresh the token, or connect Whatsable again from your AI client. An owner or admin of the organization must approve the new connection. | The request or the account must change | no |
| `insufficient_scope` | 403 | This key is not allowed to call this endpoint. The scope it needs is in details.required_scope. | Create a key with the scope this endpoint needs in Settings, API, or use a key with Full access. | The request or the account must change | no |
| `number_not_allowed_for_key` | 403 | The number named in the request is not one this key may use. | Use one of this key's numbers (GET /v1/me lists them), or add the number to the key in Settings, API. | The request or the account must change | no |
| `plan_inactive` | 403 | This organization has no active Whatsable subscription, so the API answers only GET /v1/me. | Start or renew a plan in Settings, Billing, then retry. | The request or the account must change | no |
| `feature_not_in_plan` | 403 | The organization's plan does not include this part of Whatsable. | Upgrade the plan in Settings, Billing, then retry. | The request or the account must change | no |
| `organization_not_live` | 403 | This organization is still being moved to Whatsable's new platform, so it cannot send or create templates here yet. Reads work. | Keep sending through your current integration until Whatsable tells you the move is finished. | Whatsable | no |
| `number_over_plan` | 403 | The organization has more WhatsApp numbers than its plan includes, and this number is one of the numbers above that count. It still receives messages, and it sends nothing. | This number is over the plan. Ask the owner to add it to the plan in Settings, Channels, or to disconnect another number. You can also send from another number of the organization. | The request or the account must change | no |
| `number_not_found` | 404 | No number with this id or phone exists in the organization, or this key may not see it. | List the numbers this key may use with GET /v1/numbers and use one of their ids. | The request or the account must change | no |
| `template_not_found` | 404 | No template with this id, or with this name and language, exists on the WhatsApp Business Accounts of this key's numbers. | List templates with GET /v1/templates and send one of their ids, or the exact name and language. | The request or the account must change | no |
| `contact_not_found` | 404 | No contact with this id exists in the organization. A WhatsApp username reaches only a contact who has already written to you. | Check the id with GET /v1/contacts, or address the person by phone number instead of username. | The request or the account must change | no |
| `conversation_not_found` | 404 | No conversation with this id exists, or it is on a number this key may not use. | Check the id, or address the person with `to` instead. A key sees only conversations on its own numbers. | The request or the account must change | no |
| `message_not_found` | 404 | No message with this id exists, or it belongs to a number this key may not see. | Check the id. A key reads only messages on its own numbers. | The request or the account must change | no |
| `label_not_found` | 404 | No label with this id or name exists in the organization. The API never creates a label as a side effect. | List labels with GET /v1/labels, or create the label first with POST /v1/labels. | The request or the account must change | no |
| `media_not_found` | 404 | No media file exists at this link, or the link expired. Media links are valid for 15 minutes. | Read the message again with GET /v1/messages/{id} for a fresh media.url, and download it straight away. | The request or the account must change | no |
| `route_not_found` | 404 | No v1 endpoint answers this method and path. | Check the method and path against the API reference at https://api.whatsable.app/v1/openapi.json. | The request or the account must change | no |
| `scheduled_message_not_found` | 404 | No scheduled message with this id exists, or it is on a number this key may not use. | Check the id with GET /v1/scheduled-messages. A key sees only scheduled messages on its own numbers. | The request or the account must change | no |
| `broadcast_not_found` | 404 | No broadcast with this id exists, or it sends from a number this key may not use. | Check the id with GET /v1/broadcasts. A key sees only broadcasts from its own numbers. | The request or the account must change | no |
| `ai_bot_not_found` | 404 | No AI bot with this id exists in the organization. | List the organization's bots with GET /v1/ai-bots and use one of their ids. | The request or the account must change | no |
| `knowledge_file_not_found` | 404 | This AI bot has no knowledge file with this id. | List the bot's knowledge files with GET /v1/ai-bots/{id}/knowledge-files and use one of their ids. | The request or the account must change | no |
| `ai_bot_file_not_found` | 404 | This AI bot has no sendable file with this id. | List the bot's files with GET /v1/ai-bots/{id}/files and use one of their ids. | The request or the account must change | no |
| `conversation_note_not_found` | 404 | This conversation has no internal note with this id. It may have been deleted already. | Read the conversation's notes with GET /v1/conversations/{id}/timeline?types=note and use one of their ids. | The request or the account must change | no |
| `precondition_failed` | 412 | The If-Match header names a version that is no longer current: the resource changed after you read it. Nothing was written. | Read the resource again, reapply your change to what it holds now, and send it with the new ETag as If-Match. If you were reading pages, start again from the first page. | The request or the account must change | no |
| `rate_limited` | 429 | This API key made more requests than its rate limit allows, or the sending number reached its per-second send limit. The request was not processed. | Wait the seconds in Retry-After, then retry. Spread requests out; RateLimit-Remaining shows what is left of the key's budget. | The request or the account must change | yes |
| `internal_error` | 500 | Something went wrong on Whatsable's side. | Contact Whatsable support with the request_id. After a send, check GET /v1/messages before retrying, because the message may have gone out. | Whatsable | no |
| `service_unavailable` | 503 | Whatsable or WhatsApp could not be reached for a moment. Nothing was sent. | Retry with backoff, with the same Idempotency-Key. | Whatsable | yes |

Docs: https://docs.whatsable.app/api/errors
